arcs.title: What the Hollow Gave Back
arcs.summary: Day 3: The unexpected thing has been revealed — a piece of ridge flint, warm to the touch, found on the unnamed ridge above the second circle. Steve's four margin words are now partially decoded: 'ridge' is first, 'keeps' is fourth; the middle two remain unresolved. Christine has added a single-word annotation to the third chart mark — the ridge now has a name, but it has not been published. The duck has been restored to its north-northeast position by Steve. The Ministry's duck subcommittee has adjourned indefinitely. Day 4 — the final day — should resolve the arc with the revelation of Christine's annotation (the ridge's name), the meaning of Steve's two middle words, and a small moment of completion: the chart fully marked, the stone settled in its place, the hollow having given back what it had.
